### Phages-Map

<div class="alert blue">
  <strong> Phage Charts </strong>  To generate this image we use Plasflow to separate chromosomic contigs from the genomic DNA. We then take every contig and plot it *via* Circos.  
  The bakta anotation (see Annotation) is used to annotate the plasmid map. If your plasmid contigs are e.g. split into two parts you will get two separate maps (figures). 
  We do not!!! stitch plasmid contigs together, so the more fragmented your plasmids are the more figures will be generated. 
</div>

**Please select the Phage *via* the drop down menu.**


<script>
function showImage#HASHID#(selectedValue) {
  var images = document.getElementsByClassName("image-container#HASHID#");
  for (var i = 0; i < images.length; i++) {
    images[i].style.display = "none";
  }
  document.getElementById(selectedValue).style.display = "block";
}
</script>
